parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of plastic, typically cylindrical and hollow to fit over the pen tip. It measures approximately 5 cm in length and 1.2 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip from drying out and prevents ink leakage. It may also clip onto a pocket or notebook.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or snapping into place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, typically cylindrical and tapered toward the writing tip. It measures approximately 9 cm in length and 1.2 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: The base body houses the ink reservoir and provides the main gripping area for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the structural support for the pen’s internal components.
